note: The plan sets the exact words for every row of this text-and-music piece. MG 1 to MG 7 are those words as graphics, one per row. The end card row asks for the new WAS 2027 lockup (was_lockup1.png). It is not in the end card folder yet, so the end card uses NIWRC's white logo and was_lockup1.png is still owed.

mg.title: Advocates
mg.use: One word on the beat, on the face shot. Same position as the other word cards. Out on the next cut.

mg.title: Survivors
mg.use: Only on the hands shot, never on a face. Out on the next cut so it never carries over.

mg.title: Tribal leaders
mg.src: Blueprint montage word, row 00:08–00:10. Capital T.
mg.use: One card on the beat, over the speaker at the front of the room. Same position as the others.

mg.title: Relatives
mg.use: One word on the beat, over the greeting or the hug. Out before 0:12.

mg.title: Slow down wipe
mg.use: Cut into the slow section at the middle of the wipe, at 0:12. Use it once.

mg.title: This is the room
mg.use: Lands at 00:14 and holds to 00:19 over the warm shots.

mg.title: Date and place
mg.src: Blueprint button text, row 00:20–00:28 (NIWRC dates, 1 Oct).
mg.use: The button text stack over the room wide. Only this date, never another one.

mg.title: End card
mg.cue: was_lockup1.png only (the new WAS 2027 lockup). Never the old two-women lockup.
mg.src: NIWRC logo (white) from NIWRC's onboarding brand file, in the brand kit 10 Oct 2026. Client rule: white logo on red.
mg.use: This is the end card. Put it at 00:28 after the last line and hold it to the end. The script wants the new WAS 2027 lockup (was_lockup1.png) here. It is not in the end card folder yet, so this card is the NIWRC logo, white on red. Swap in was_lockup1.png when it is there. Never the old two-women lockup.
